column6: …… who respects ……. @wRN{@wDN{Sîn}-iddinam} …… his departing boat. He provided flour, gold and grain, befitting the great lady. …… this choice grain, …… the lapis lazuli @wTN{E-kur}.

He transported this cargo to the Quay of Life, the quay of @wSN{Urim}. Joyously he brought it into the majestic house, the house of @wDN{Suen}. @wDN{Nanna} was delighted with the king, and @wDN{Ningal} …… to him. @wDN{Nanna} was delighted with @wRN{@wDN{Sîn}-iddinam}, and @wDN{Ningal} …… to him. The @wDN{Anuna}, the great gods, blessed him. He had brought to complete perfection the plenitude, the pure first-fruit offerings, the first-fruit offerings of the new year. @vart[t2661.v1,t2661.v1]{@varn{1 ms. adds 1 line:} He had transported this cargo to the Quay of Life, the quay of @wSN{Urim}. }

@wDN{Suen} put in order the food offerings and, after he had taken them to @wSN{Nibru}, @vart[t2661.v2,t2661.v2]{@varn{1 ms. adds 1 line:} and had brought them into the @wTN{E-kur}, the house of @wDN{Enlil}, } @wDN{Enlil}, delighted with the food offerings, fixed a good destiny. His own mother, the great lady @wDN{Ninlil}, expressed deserved affection.

@vart[t2661.v3,t2661.v3]{@varn{1 ms. adds 1 line:} @wDN{Suen} addressed @wDN{Enlil} and @wDN{Ninlil}. } He prayed to them to determine an eternal destiny for @wRN{@wDN{Sîn}-iddinam}: @q[Suen,Enlil Ninlil]{“May the life of the humble shepherd whom you favourably address ……. May the life of @wRN{@wDN{Sîn}-iddinam} whom you favourably address ……. As a just destiny, may a life into the distant future be determined for him in destiny. May he be allotted long-lasting life.”}

@q{“As I bring this choice grain to the lapis lazuli @wTN{E-kur} for you, may he hasten …… thick bread …… like this threshed grain. Let us give him years of favour, days of life and months of success. In his palace you will bring to him in perfection what pleases the spirit and gladdens the heart. May you be the gift of life for @wRN{@wDN{Sîn}-iddinam}, who discourses pleasingly! May the royal throne rise high and endure eternally! Forever make foreign lands submit to his great name!”}
